identity.title: Project principal, workflow, invocation and policy snapshot references from evidence

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Extend the source-neutral ExecutionProjection with optional governance context refs populated only from explicit normalized evidence. Do not add auth/session behavior and do not infer identity from model names, filenames or prose. Dependency: 8032.document-governance-context-v1.
human_pressure.why_now: After 8032 freezes the contract, the read-side projection needs these refs so authority, approval, budget and audit can share stable context without coupling to producer-private history.
do_not_misread: This repository is the canonical Ailuros governance runtime; do not apply cleanup assumptions from the legacy MCP Gateway repository.
Identity references are governance provenance, not login/authentication/session management.
Approval and budget in this batch are evidence-backed records/projections, not workflow/payment services.
Do not turn Ailuros into an agent executor or coding harness.

machine_core.goal: Project governance context deterministically into the existing execution read model.
invariants: Depends on: 8032.document-governance-context-v1. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
Context refs are derived read-side facts.
Authority remains a separate evidence-backed dimension from 8028.
contracts: Projection preserves both governance refs and their evidence provenance.
failure_semantics: Missing governance-context evidence remains unknown/absent; it is never inferred as allowed, approved, within budget or clean.
Explicit denial/violation evidence is preserved with evidence refs.
Derived control-context state remains rebuildable from immutable evidence.
Producer-native values remain preserved alongside normalized projections.

steps.title: Extend projection model minimally
details: Add optional principal_ref, workflow_ref, invocation_ref, policy_snapshot_ref directly or under one small GovernanceContext model.
Do not create identity/auth/session service abstractions.

steps.title: Project explicit evidence only
details: Map canonical governance_context evidence fields when present.
Do not infer principal from backend/model/role or workflow from run_id.
Retain evidence refs/source pointers for projected context.

steps.title: Handle absent/conflicting context truthfully
details: Conflicting explicit values produce diagnostics/evidence inconsistency rather than last-write-wins.

steps.title: Prove source neutrality
details: Test one EverRun-like fixture and one generic second-producer fixture.
Core must not branch on producer name.

acceptance: ExecutionProjection exposes optional governance context refs.
No context value is inferred from unrelated fields.
Conflicts are visible and do not silently resolve.
No auth/session/IAM/runtime execution capability is added.

must_check: Identity refs do not become authority decisions.
reject_if: workflow_ref is made equivalent to Ailuros run_id.
Conflicting context silently becomes one chosen value.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed/approved/within-budget.
